obligations.statement: The clamp must support the weight of the monitor arm without slipping or rotating.
derivation_premises: A load that is not reacted accelerates the body.
Contents that cannot be reached are not stored.

obligations.statement: The clamp must fit desk edges with thickness between 18 and 40 mm.
derivation_premises: A part that cannot fit cannot function.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be removable and relocatable without tools.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that cannot be disengaged cannot be removed.
A user must be able to operate the mechanism without tools.

obligations.statement: The clamp must allow the monitor arm to be attached and supported.
derivation_premises: An arm that cannot be attached cannot be fixed.

obligations.statement: The clamp must maintain its position on the desk edge under the weight of the arm.
derivation_premises: A clamp that slips or rotates fails its primary function.

obligations.statement: The clamp must provide a means to be tightened and loosened by hand.
derivation_premises: A user must be able to apply force by hand without tools.

obligations.statement: The clamp must provide a reaction point for the clamp force on the desk edge.
derivation_premises: A load that is not reacted accelerates the body.

obligations.statement: The clamp must have a structure that can transmit the load from the arm to the desk edge.
derivation_premises: A structure that cannot carry load will fail.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be able to be manufactured with the chosen principle family.
derivation_premises: A product that cannot be made cannot exist.
